meta.description: A desert fief, a cracked cistern, a people with the water, a blade left behind. Rules on the table.

schema.doc: Someone the d20 rules apply to: three stats, skills, vigor, water, and the verbs of a fight.

attack.doc: Strike someone here: opposed roll, a ward stops fast blows, slow passes it at -2

brace.doc: Guard yourself: +3 to defence until your next deed

challenge.doc: Call someone out: a duel nobody else may enter

check.doc: Try something against a difficulty: d20 + stat + skill vs dc (default 12)

params.skill: blade, brawl, climb, stealth, survival, lore, parley, resolve

crawl.doc: Drag yourself to a connected place, even when down

drink.doc: Drink from a skin or a vessel within reach (+4 water)

fill.doc: Fill a skin you hold at a source here

parley.doc: Talk terms: wits + parley against their will; success emits agreed with your offer

params.offer: what you put on the table

search.doc: Take everything off someone who is down or dead

threaten.doc: Opposed will; a weapon in hand helps you, friends at their side help them

yield.doc: Give up to someone here; striking you after that is dishonor

schema.doc: Something that can act. Characters, monsters.
A side. Hidden; people name it in state.faction, standing edges point at it.
A person who fights without a mind: in a duel, or against the outlawed.
Someone of the Reach: walks, carries, talks, and fights by the rules.

creep.doc: Walk with the broken step: twice as long, the sand does not hear you

give.doc: Hand something you hold to someone here

params.item: id or name of a thing you hold

go.doc: Walk to a connected place (loud on deep sand)

schema.doc: Something that contains other things. Locations.
The rails. Hidden; holds the facts the story has seen.
What lives under the deep sand. It comes to rhythm.

state.description: You do not see it. You see the dune move.

schema.doc: Emberglass in the sand. Harvesting takes time and makes noise.

harvest.doc: Dig a shard out (20 s, and the sand hears it)

schema.doc: A belt ward. On, it hardens against anything fast.

state.description_on: A belt plate with a thumb-switch. A faint hum when it is on.

script.source:
def apply(ctx):
    text = ctx.target.state.text or "nothing is written on it"
    ctx.emit("read", target=ctx.target, reach=0, text=text)
    ctx.log(text)
    return text

state.default_line: Ossa taps the ledger. 'Water in, glass out. Talk to me in those two words and we understand each other.'
state.description: Ossa the Carrier, broad and brown, a ledger on a cord round her neck and a water-tally on the other.

dram|hollis|clerk.else: 'Hollis is no clerk of mine. The paper was Dreyer's. I took the glass and said nothing, and now I have said it.'
dram|hollis|clerk.line: 'My clerk? He came with my convoy on good paper.' She does not look at you. 'Good paper is cheap in the Reach.'

dialog.dreyer: 'Dreyer had this Hold eleven years and the Guild carried for them. Then the well. Then the writ went to Varrick. The Guild carries for whoever holds the gate.'
dialog.glass|ember|emberglass|flats: 'Veins on the Flats, dull red, you cannot miss them. Dig quiet. The last fool who dug loud I never had to pay.'
dialog.keth|desert|deepwell: 'The Keth have water the Guild would give a year's cut to carry. They do not sell. Whoever gets terms with them owns this road.'
dialog.water|skin|drink|buy|price: 'Water is a full skin for one shard of glass. Hand me the glass and the skin is yours. No glass, no water; the Guild does not run a well.'

goals.text: Glass in, water out, the Guild's cut on both
goals.why: the Guild carries for whoever holds the gate

state.default_line: Ruhl grunts. 'Reeve's business, not mine. Ask me about the walls or the men.'
state.description: Captain of the Hold's guard. Grey, square, a scar across the knuckles of the sword hand.

dialog.clerk|carrier|dram|hollis: 'Came with the water convoy, stayed when it left. Papers in order. I do not like how he stands.'
dialog.fight|duel|ring|challenge: 'The yard is a ring by old law. Called out in it, a reeve answers or the men stop being his. I did not make the law.'
dialog.keth|desert|water|well: 'The Keth have water under the rock somewhere north. Dreyer tried to take it and poisoned a well instead. They will not talk to a Hold man. Might talk to you.'
dialog.men|guard|guards|garrison: 'Nine men and me. Six who can hold a blade. The clerk from the Carriers watches them drill like a man counting.'
dialog.thresher|sand|flats|dune: 'Walk the Flats loud and the sand comes up and eats you. The Keth walk it like they are dancing. Learn that or stay off the glass.'
dialog.wall|walls|gate|hold|defend: 'Walls are sound. Water is not. Twelve days of it in the cistern if nobody washes, and nobody washes.'

goals.why: the men follow a live reeve

state.default_line: Hollis smiles with the lower half of his face. 'Guild business, Reeve. Dull as dust.'
state.description: The Carriers' clerk, a lean man with ink on two fingers and no ink on the rest.

dialog.dreyer|house: 'Dreyer? Gone. Lost the writ, lost the Hold, lost the water. A house that loses is a story, not a house.'
dialog.papers|guild|carrier|clerk|book: 'Carriers' book, all in order. Water in, glass out, the Guild's cut. I count.'
dialog.ring|duel|fight|blade: 'A fine old custom, the ring. Any man may call. Any reeve must answer. I read it in the Hold's own book.'

goals.text: The reeve, in the ring, before the moon turns

state.orders: the reeve, in the ring, before the moon turns

state.text: By the Crown: the fief of Scar Gate and the Glass Flats to House Varrick, with the water, the road and the glass, and the duty of the gate. Dreyer to quit the Reach within the season.
GUILD TALLY. Water: one skin per shard. Glass: by weight, Guild's cut a third. Convoy south at the moon's turn. The Guild carries for whoever holds the gate.

state.brief: You are Sefa of the Keth. Taan sent you up the ridge to watch the new reeve. Dreyer poisoned the old well and the Keth have not shared water with the Hold since. The Deepwell is yours to keep secret or to show. You know the Flats and how to walk them quiet.
state.description: A Keth scout in sand-colored cloth, a knife at the small of her back, eyes on the Hold.

goals.text: Learn what the new reeve wants with the Flats
goals.why: Taan needs to know careful or afraid

goals.text: Keep the Deepwell secret unless they earn it
goals.why: the Low Well is a grave

goals.text: Bring a skin of water back to Taan
goals.why: you left with one and she counts

state.default_line: Taan lets the drip fall three times before she answers. 'You came a long way down to ask me nothing.'
state.description: Elder Taan, small and very old, sitting where the drip from the roof lands in a stone cup.

dialog.dreyer|poison: 'Four of mine died at the Low Well, two of them children. The Hold did that, whatever name it wore. I do not forget it. I may set it down.'
dialog.sefa|scout|nico: 'My scouts watch you from the ridge. If you are here, one of them let you be here. Remember that.'
dialog.thresher|sand|flats: 'The Thresher is the Reach's own. Walk the broken step and it does not hear you. Dig the glass and it does. Your people do not know that yet.'
dialog.truce|terms|peace|treaty: 'Terms are not a wish. Say what the Hold gives and what it stays away from, and we will see if it weighs anything.'
dialog.water|well|deepwell|cistern|share: 'This water was here before the Hold and will be here after. Dreyer wanted it and put poison in the Low Well. You want it too. Tell me why you are not Dreyer, in terms I can carry.'

goals.why: the Low Well is a grave

goals.text: Terms that weigh something, if the Hold brings any
goals.why: children should not drink in the dark

state.default_line: Nico does not take the glass from his eye. 'Hm.'
state.description: A Keth scout, young, cross-legged on the rock with a long glass in one hand, watching the Hold.

dialog.dram|clerk|carrier: 'The one in the yard who watches the drill? He walks like a blade. He is nobody's clerk.'
dialog.hold|reeve|varrick: 'Nine days you have been in there. Nine days and no patrol on the Flats. Either you are careful or you are afraid. Taan wants to know which.'
dialog.thresher|flats|sand|glass: 'Loud step, two, three, and it turns. Broken step and you are wind. You hear the hum, you run for rock and you do not look back.'
dialog.water|well|deepwell|cistern|keth: 'Water is for the Keth and the Keth's friends.' He lowers the glass. 'Are you a friend? Friends bring something.'

goals.text: Watch the Hold, report to Taan

state.brief: You are Ansel Varrick, reeve of a fief your house was handed and nobody wanted. The cistern is cracked. The Keth have the water and no reason to share it. Somebody Dreyer left behind is in your walls. You have a blade you can use a little, a tongue you can use well, a ward, and Captain Ruhl.
state.description: Reeve of Scar Gate by the Crown's writ, nine days in the post, sand in everything already.

goals.text: Water for the Hold before the cistern fails
goals.why: nine men and the Keth between you and the dry
no truce has held since Dreyer poisoned the Low Well

goals.text: Find who Dreyer left behind in the Hold
goals.why: a house does not lose a fief and leave nothing in the walls

state.description: A squat stone hold wedged into the only gap in the Scar. A cracked cistern under the floor, a hall with a map nobody trusts, and the gate yard beyond the inner door.
Packed sand inside the gate, a ring scratched in it by old law. Guards drill in the shade of the wall.
The one road out, white with salt, running north between the Scar and the glass. Convoy ruts, a dead crawler, wind.
Black glass underfoot, red dunes walking across it. Veins of dull red where the dunes have pulled back. Every step rings.
A spine of red rock standing out of the glass. Shade, a view of everything, goat sign on the stone.
A cavern under the ridge where the rock sweats water into a black pool. Cups on cords, a cookfire, the smell of wet stone.
A flat of hard pan where the Guild's crawlers put down. Water casks under tarps, a tally post, one broad woman with a ledger.
A Dreyer crawler on its side, half sunk, ribs of it showing. Things glint in the wreck. The sand here is soft and deep.
Under the dunes. Nothing lives here but the one thing that does.
A straight court blade, better made than its owner can use.
A stone tank under the floor with a crack you can put two fingers in. Twelve draws left, Ruhl says.
Narrow, dark, no ornament. A blade for the slow stroke through a ward.
Wooden blades, weighted. Nobody dies in the ring on these. Nobody wins on them either.
Guild casks under a tarp, each one tallied. Ossa's eye is on them.
A crawler's breaker bar. Slow, and heavy enough that slow is enough.
Short, curved, kept sharper than it needs to be.
A brass spyglass, Carrier make, the lens scratched.
Cups worn smooth, one for each Keth who has ever drunk here.
You do not see it. You see the dune move.
A seam of dull red in the black glass, warm to the hand.
A thinner seam, half under the dune's edge.
A belt plate with a thumb-switch. A faint hum when it is on.
